ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Comics & Zines. Undergraduate Section. The yield sign icon indicates that there are open seats, but some seats may be restricted to majors or minors. Check your registration screen to see if there is an open seat for you. This hybrid course combines online/remote learning with weekly in-person activities. Most course content will be delivered through Compass 2g, with weekly tasks and online content. In-person class meetings will be reserved for working on projects in the studio, and will comply with CDC guidelines. Students who have concerns or challenges related to meeting in person on campus should contact the instructor asap to discuss accommodations.
